rows.definition: Evidence classification for observed throughput backed by named benchmark or issue evidence.
rows.distinction: ClassWitnessed classifies measured native-performance throughput backed by named evidence; projected floors and roofs use ClassHypothesis. It is not dispatchtick.ClaimWitnessed, the closure-audit verdict for a worker commit.

rows.definition: cmd/fak.renderNativePerformance projects a validated nativeperf.Graph into the human hill-climb report: envelope and comparison headers, the enabled/status/rung checklist, expected-versus-witnessed throughput, feature stack, gaps, and independent envelopes.
rows.distinction: It renders an already-built native-performance graph and performs no model execution or measurement. Unlike the agentdemo RenderText transcript, its rows expose performance evidence classes and next-witness obligations.

rows.definition: NativePerfDecisionJournal.SelectedCandidateID identifies the selected obligation node promotion witness bound into one replayable native-performance gate decision.
rows.distinction: This is the immutable decision journal binding to a supplied graph candidate; Candidate is a scored resident span considered by the context planner. The journal identifier does not establish hardware execution or serving promotion.

rows.definition: Explicit arithmetic admission policy binding a roofline receipt to a named device, memory bandwidth metric, units, memory/workload scope, denominator kind and minimum attainment and numerical-similarity thresholds.
rows.distinction: RooflinePolicy declares comparable dimensions and numeric acceptance thresholds; ClassWitnessed classifies observed benchmark evidence. Passing this policy does not establish physical execution, qualify a measured ceiling, or promote a theoretical ceiling to measured evidence.

rows.definition: Named compatibility preset selecting the original Strix Halo theoretical device-DRAM roofline campaign, accepted device aliases, full-ceiling denominator kind, 80-percent attainment target and legacy numerical-similarity floor; it supplies no bandwidth ceiling.
rows.distinction: This function constructs one explicitly named legacy RooflinePolicy, not a policy inferred from another device and not the validator or a measurement. Unlike arbitrary RooflinePolicy values it fixes the historical theoretical campaign; a measured ceiling requires a separate explicit policy and independent qualification.

rows.definition: Pure roofline receipt validation operation that checks an explicit RooflinePolicy, full-ceiling provenance and matching device, metric, units and scope before computing attainment and enforcing the declared numerical thresholds.
rows.distinction: The validator applies a supplied RooflinePolicy rather than declaring one or selecting the LegacyStrixHaloRooflinePolicy preset. Arithmetic acceptance is not physical-execution authority, measured-ceiling qualification or permission to relabel theoretical evidence.

rows.definition: Stable error sentinel for an invalid explicit roofline-policy configuration, including missing identity or scope, unsupported denominator dimensions, invalid aliases, and nonfinite or out-of-range thresholds.
rows.distinction: This error labels configuration refusal from RooflinePolicy validation; it is not a policy instance, the legacy preset, or the ValidateRooflineAttainmentWithPolicy operation. It does not certify receipt evidence and remains distinct from denominator incompatibility and below-target attainment errors.
